$comment: Colorway variants derived from a bundled base template. Each entry remaps the base layout sources, structure index and design document onto a new palette; the generator renders fresh previews. `baseCategory` defaults to the variant's own category and lets one geometry family (e.g. dsh-slate-grid) seed colorways across several categories. Add an entry here to extend the catalogue.

replacements: A neutral, structure-first presentation system on white (#ffffff)
